provenance: Authored before live evaluation; synthetic fixture only. SQL is independently authored for each case, separate from production query construction. No live outcome has been used for prompt tuning.

cases.question: How many orders are there across all statuses?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS value FROM orders

cases.question: What is the total delivered revenue?
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(i.price*i.quantity) AS value FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered'

cases.question: Count all orders by customer state.
cases.sql: SELECT c.customer_state AS group_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 20

cases.question: How many canceled orders belong to customers in MH?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status='canceled' AND c.customer_state='MH'

cases.question: Show delivered revenue by product category.
cases.sql: SELECT p.category AS group_value, SUM(i.price*i.quantity) AS value FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 20

cases.question: What is the average review score across reviewed orders?
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS value FROM orders o JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id=o.order_id

cases.question: What is the average number of days from order to delivery for delivered orders?
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(delivered_date)-julianday(order_date)) AS value FROM orders WHERE delivered_date IS NOT NULL AND order_status='delivered'

cases.question: Count all orders for customer state ZZ.
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state='ZZ'
